title: ABIDES-MARL: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Environment for Optimal Execution with Endogenous Liquidity
abstract: arXiv:2511.02016v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Classical optimal execution models treat market impact as a pre-specified, exogenous process. However, when market makers adapt strategically, this assumption becomes a structural misspecification: execution dynamics depend on the policies and actions of other agents. The problem therefore ceases to be a single-agent control problem and instead becomes a finite-horizon stochastic game, in which liquidity emerges endogenously from the interactions among heterogeneous market players. We hence introduce ABIDES-MARL, a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for studying optimal execution under endogenous liquidity in a realistic limit order book setting. The framework extends ABIDES-Gym to support multiple learning agents with synchronized decision periods that preserve proper information filtration and key market microstructure features. We validate the framework in an extended Kyle setting, where multiple learning agents recovers

translated_title: ABIDES-MARL：一个具有内生流动性的最优执行多智能体强化学习环境
translated_abstract: arXiv:2511.02016v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：经典最优执行模型将市场影响视为预先指定的外生过程。然而，当市场做市商策略性地适应时，这一假设就变成了结构性错误设定：执行动态取决于其他智能体的策略和行动。因此，该问题不再是一个单智能体控制问题，而成为一个有限时域随机博弈，其中流动性从异质市场参与者之间的相互作用中内生涌现。为此，我们引入了ABIDES-MARL，这是一个多智能体强化学习框架，用于在真实限价订单簿环境中研究内生流动性下的最优执行。该框架扩展了ABIDES-Gym，以支持具有同步决策周期的多个学习智能体，同时保留适当的信息过滤和关键市场微观结构特征。我们在扩展的Kyle环境中验证了该框架，其中多个学习智能体恢复了理论结果。
tldr: 本文提出了ABIDES-MARL框架，将最优执行问题从单智能体控制扩展为内生流动性下的多智能体随机博弈，并在限价订单簿环境中验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ABIDES-MARL, a framework that extends optimal execution from single-agent control to a multi-agent stochastic game with endogenous liquidity, validated in a limit order book setting.
